question:
A capacitor is connected to an AC source of fixed peak voltage. If the frequency of the source is increased to twice its initial value, state:
(i) how the capacitive reactance changes
(ii) how the peak current changes

options.A:
(i) Capacitive reactance doubles.
(ii) Peak current becomes half.
options.B:
(i) Capacitive reactance remains unchanged.
(ii) Peak current remains unchanged.
options.C:
(i) Capacitive reactance becomes half.
(ii) Peak current becomes double.
options.D:
(i) Capacitive reactance becomes one-fourth.
(ii) Peak current becomes four times.
